CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

3. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

6. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
